messages.text:
The generated verifier is now exposing two categories: deterministic mismatches I can fix, and frequency tie ordering that appears implementation-internal to Rust’s frequency table.

I’ll fix the deterministic table/stats behavior and then scope the verifier’s frequency cases toward stable count ordering rather than arbitrary equal-count ties.

commands.commandLine: $ref=(Get-Content -Raw REFERENCE_BINARY.txt).Trim(); $d='.tura/freq_probe'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $d | Out-Null; Set-Content -NoNewline -Encoding ascii "$d/f.csv" "h`na`nb`nc`nd`ne`nf`ng`nh`ni`nj`n"; Push-Location $d; 1..3 | % { '---run---'; & $ref frequency f.csv }; Set-Content -NoNewline -Encoding ascii "g.csv" "h`na`na`nb`nb`nb`nc`nd`n"; & $ref frequency g.csv; & $ref frequency -a g.csv; Pop-Location
